causal_chain: The retained save-184 input has corps_front_sectors={} and ABB retains assigned_sub_segment_id subseg:sector:hvo_tomislavgrad:0:0. resolveRoutineMovementScope therefore returns unrestricted stale_assignment.

At T3 the queued bot_discretionary destination Bravnice has operation_authorized=false and reassignment_authorized=false, but isRoutineScopeEnforcedForOrder returns false at brigade_routine_scope.ts:538-539 because the routing scope is unrestricted. The unchanged T3 path guard passes and a four-turn Bravnice transit is written.

partition-corps-front-sectors replaces sector truth through war_phases.ts:1605-1607. buildCorpsFrontSectors calls syncSectorAssignmentsToFormations at corps_front_sectors.ts:773-774, whose brigade_assignment.ts:2701-2722 clearing pass removes derived assigned_sub_segment_id. The exact capture observes ABB cleared at the partition boundary.

assign-brigades-to-subsegments immediately follows partition and directly writes assigned_sub_segment_id at subsegment_assignment.ts:103-109 or 266-276. By the later captured boundary ABB is restricted to Bosansko Grahovo 2, Malesevci, and Prekaja 2.

At T6 ABB is at valid Malesevci; Bravnice is outside the rebuilt assigned-front set; operation and reassignment authority are both false. commander_march_correction.ts:167-180 therefore deletes the transit and order.

operation_identity.interpretation: Jajce_3 is a friendly approach to current Lupnica; Livno_2 is axis staging. Bravnice is an earlier completed objective and is neither current-or-later approach nor staging.

operation_hash_change.established: Preparation Probe: Operation Southern Move is removed from the receiving active_operations array, count 3 to 2; selected Mistral roster, axis status, current objective index, current objective, and Bravnice/Jajce_3 authorization remain unchanged.
operation_hash_change.limit: The evidence does not establish that probe removal is the only mutation across every field of the surviving Southern Move operation.

measured: Exact save-184/scenario prelude and all 85 registered phase-prefix executions through generate-bot-brigade-orders, without runTurn or turn 186.
T3 input scope/order/authority and resulting Bravnice transit.
ABB assigned_sub_segment_id is null after partition and restored by the later captured boundary.
T6 preconditions at the prior captured boundary and deletion at commander-correct-march-orders.
Operation membership and authorized destination sets at every captured boundary.
source_proven: The T3 unrestricted-scope early return and T6 deletion branch are deterministic for the captured operands.
The sector builder's sync clears derived sub-segment ownership and assignBrigadesToSubSegments can restore it.
inferred_not_directly_instrumented: assign-brigades-to-subsegments is the first effective reassignment writer: it immediately follows partition and is the identified direct writer, but the probe did not snapshot immediately after that phase.
The claimed rebuilt total of 54 sectors is not recorded in the sealed probe. The review accepts a rebuilt non-empty map, not the numeric count 54.

findings.finding: The 753 candidate may not choose an arbitrary destination from getOperationAuthorizedDestinations and may not infer operation ownership from owner=bot_discretionary. In the exact state the authorized set contains both Jajce_3 approach and Livno_2 staging, while stale/unrestricted scope makes routine-scope validity non-discriminating.
findings.required_narrowing: Require one eligible planning/execution operation and one ABB axis; prove the old destination is an earlier completed objective on that same axis and is no longer current approach/staging; exclude explicit reassignment, lawful retreat/recovery, valid staging, already-authorized orders, and unrelated bot orders; then reuse getSectorOffensiveApproachOsids plus findNearestFriendlyOsidDestination for the current objective. Ambiguous ownership, no lawful approach, or invalid path must use existing rejection/handling without forced progress.
findings.impact: The diagnosis passes, but the candidate is not ready to implement until these constraints are encoded in its design and focused tests.

findings.finding: The probe captures null assignment after partition and a restored assignment only at the later advance-sector-offensives boundary. The direct assign phase and the total sector count were not separately snapshotted.
findings.required_correction: Describe assign-brigades-to-subsegments as the source-supported first identified writer, and omit the total of 54 unless another retained artifact pins it.
findings.impact: No change to the established T3-to-T6 cause; this limits attribution precision.

smallest_lawful_candidate.replacement_selection: Derive current-objective approaches with the existing operation producer helper and select with the existing deterministic nearest-friendly-destination BFS. Do not pick any arbitrary member of the union authorization set.

positive: Exact save-184-derived ABB case identifies Bravnice as a completed earlier objective of the unique Mistral/Sipovo axis and selects Jajce_3 through the existing current-objective approach selector only when the existing path guard passes.
The reconciled Jajce_3 order creates lawful transit and remains valid through T6.
Candidate selection is deterministic and insertion-order independent.
negative: An already-authorized Jajce_3 approach remains semantic/byte equivalent.
A valid Livno_2 staging order remains unchanged.
Explicit reassignment and lawful retreat/recovery remain unchanged.
An unrelated bot_discretionary order is not treated as operation-owned merely because ABB is an operation participant.
Nonparticipant, recovery/completed operation, multiple eligible operations or axes, empty approach set, and invalid path do not retarget or force transit.
Bravnice remains unauthorized under rebuilt scope and T6 still deletes an independently injected invalid Bravnice transit.
Loan receiver operation lookup and home-corps reassignment/path ownership remain unchanged.

limits: The earlier Bravnice order emitter remains unmeasured.
